_comment: Hints the extractor cannot infer from the API itself, keyed by Type or
Type::method. The `ignore` list (methods never bound) lives in
binding-coverage.json so exclusions have a single source of truth.
types  - is each handle a resource/class, and does it need interior
mutability (Mutex) because some methods take &mut self?
hints  - per-method runtime hints, e.g. cpuBound -> BEAM DirtyCpu.
manual - backend ids that hand-write a method instead of generating it
(the escape hatch: param construction, generics, etc.).
